rationale: With only 25 minutes to close, price is fading below both the 5-min VWAP ($68.44) and 9-EMA ($68.53), which argues short-side, but the stock has already surrendered ~4.3% from its intraday high and is sitting mid-range — mean-reversion upward is equally plausible in a thin late-session tape. The 35 bps spread, ATR of only $0.36 per bar, and no news catalyst provide insufficient edge to justify the risk given today's existing P&L deficit and the very limited time remaining for a trade to develop.
